title: Amaziah Opposes Amos
summary: Amaziah, priest of Bethel, tells Jeroboam that Amos has conspired against him, claiming he said Jeroboam will die by the sword and Israel will go into exile. He tells Amos, 'O thou seer, go, flee thee away into the land of Judah,' and not to prophesy at Bethel, the king's sanctuary. Amos answers that he is no prophet but a herdsman and gatherer of sycomore fruit, and the LORD took him. He foretells that Amaziah's wife will become a harlot and Israel will go into exile.
